title: A sustainable approach to the development and characterization of chitosan thiomer beads for the efficient removal of Cd(II) ions from aqueous effluents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33695-33707
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04050G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wesam Abd El-Fattah, Ahlem Guesmi, Naoufel Ben Hamadi, Rana Yahya, Thamer S. Alraddadi, Ahmed Shahat, Reda F. M. Elshaarawy
This study presents a facile protocol for fabricating a new sustainable biosorbent, cross-linked chitosan thiomer beads (CLCTB), as an eco-friendly scavenger for Cd2+ ions from aqueous effluents.
